level3_summary: Use thought groups and context-sensitive stress, intonation and rhythm to understand and convey intentions and attitudes.
Apply spelling-sound patterns and use phonetic notation to learn pronunciation.
Learn contextual meanings, grammatical functions and common word-formation patterns.
Use vocabulary to name, describe, explain and exchange theme-related information.
language_knowledge.caveat: Approximate body targets are distinct from the appendix exact505+1095headword counts. Level3+is an extension, not every learner or city exam requirement.

level3_summary: Relate form, meaning and use in context; recognise sentence structure and constituent relationships.
Understand and use grammar in oral/written narration, description and explanation.
Recognise purpose, structure, language and information organisation in narrative, explanation and practical texts.
Use cohesion and coherence to understand accurately and communicate logically.
language_knowledge.extension_only: Argumentative text structure and reasoning methods are level3+.

level3_summary: Choose suitable verbal and nonverbal ways to request help and communicate in social situations.
Adapt formality, directness and politeness to relationships and context.
Interpret others’ feelings, attitudes and views and express one’s own appropriately.
language_knowledge.caveat: These body requirements address communicative functions; the contents contain no separately titled function/notional appendix.

pronunciation_appendix.instruction_summary: Teach sound with meaning and context through input, imitation and practice; phonetic notation is designated only for grades7–9.
